description: Opening and first-story dialogue in Blue and Red.

english: Hey, everyone! Nice to meet you! Thanks for starting up the Digimon Battle Review Board!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: The anime hasn't even started yet, and you're already such devoted fans!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Before we begin, let me introduce my friends!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: They're tiny, but there are lots of them. The Starmons are a lively bunch!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: When they gather together, they become the mighty Star Sword!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: And Taiki's rival has been acting strangely, too.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: There's Kiriha Aonuma, the cool and mysterious boy, for better or worse. And there's Nene Amano, a girl who's mysterious in all sorts of ways. Which one you face depends on the version you play! To uncover Kiriha's secret, play Blue Flare. To solve Nene's mystery, play Twilight!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Wait, isn't Zenjiro a rival too?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: No... The enemy captured him along with us.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Besides, no one would buy a Zenjiro version!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Now, in the strange world of Elestou Zone... our adventure together is about to begin!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: We did it!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: You sure did! That's our Taiki! I knew I picked the right General!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Heh... Not bad! But that was just a warm-up. I only pretended to be weak so I could gauge your strength!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: You got knocked clear across the room...
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Quiet, you little weakling! You have no idea how frightening I am when I get serious. I'll show you right now!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: That is an astonishing amount of sore-loser talk...
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I'm used to stubborn foes. If you won't give up, we'll beat you as many times as it takes!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Spadamon! Thank goodness you're safe!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I'm sorry I'm late. I left everyone behind and hid by myself this whole time. I'm sorry.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: What are you talking about? You did nothing wrong! If they had captured you, this Zone would have been finished!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: What do you mean?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Spadamon isn't an ordinary Digimon. He's a Weapon Digimon, the guardian of this Zone. He has tremendous power hidden within him. We can't let the villains take him!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Spadamon is a god?!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: N-no, nothing so grand! I was made to protect this Zone, but I can't defeat the invaders myself. All I can do is find allies, bring them together, and guide them. That's all.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: That reminds me. Where are our friends?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I think they were taken to the Central Room. Be careful, though. The Digimon in there is frightening... in a way.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...I've got to ask. What do you mean, 'in a way'?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I peeked in there once. He was laughing happily, then suddenly got very angry, and finally started crying. But when I looked closer... he was talking to himself the whole time.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Frightening... or just dangerous?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: You're the boss, aren't you?!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...Who are you? Who gave you permission to come in here? Get out!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: We're not leaving. You are! This place belongs to us: this room, this fort, and this entire Zone! We won't hand any of it over!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Ah, I remember you. The coward who abandoned his friends and fled. Now you've come back with a few pitiful allies. What do you intend to do this time?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Isn't it obvious? We're going to knock you villains down!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: And take back our friends and this Zone!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Pathetic fools. Die regretting your own stupidity.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: We've heard that line before. Enjoy sounding tough while you can. Nobody who's talked to us like that has come out unscathed!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Your scheme ends here! Give up and get out of this Zone!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...I see. You truly are extraordinary fools.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...What is he talking about?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Thanks to all of you defeating that Digimon, one of the seals suppressing my power has come undone. Thank you, everyone.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: So that's the power of the Weapon Digimon who protects Elestou Zone... If we break the other seals, can Spadamon regain his power?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: What's this? Something's written on it... 'Commander Room Save PC: Preparing'...?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: This looks like one of those machines at a bank...
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I think so. You can deposit BIT! Maybe I'll put some in... Oh, right. I don't have any BIT.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: What's this?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: This is the Sky Port, the Digimon Air Corps' airfield. They fly in and out from here. Switch on that console over there...
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...and an Airport Gate opens, letting you travel to other airports. Elestou Zone has Fort Island, home of Sky Fort; volcanic Crystal Island; mountainous Hyde Island; and the vast Energy Continent stretching north and south.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Once an Airport Gate is open, you can go anywhere. Just talk to a member of the Digimon Air Corps, and they'll fly you to any airport in no time!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Amazing!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: But there's a problem right now, so I can't open the Airport Gate. Sorry, Taiki!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I see... That's too bad.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Is this an airfield?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Yes. The Digimon Air Corps uses it. It's called the Sky Port, the airport at Sky Fort.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: If you switch on that console...
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...the Airport Gate opens, and you can travel to other airports. Elestou Zone has Fort Island, home of Sky Fort; volcanic Crystal Island; mountainous Hyde Island; and the vast Energy Continent stretching north and south.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: You can reach any airport in Elestou Zone from here. Once you've opened the airport's gate, just talk to a member of the Digimon Air Corps.
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: That's amazing! Now we can finally go rescue the Digimon who were taken away!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Taiki... Do you really think I can save my friends?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Of course you can! We're all with you. Everything will be all right!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: What's this? It says... 'DigiTent Save PC: Preparing'...?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Hey, everyone! Nice to meet you!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Nice to meet you too!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Before we begin, let me introduce my friends!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: They're tiny, but there are lots of them! The Pickmons are a lively bunch!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: When they combine with Starmon, they become the powerful Star Sword!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: I-I don't know anything about that! If it existed, I'd have driven you out long ago!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: ...True. If it existed, we'd have found it. Everything we've discovered has been a disappointment. You useless liars have served your purpose! I'll throw you all out and see whether you can fly!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Stop!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: L-leave Patamon alone!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Your voice is cracking so badly I can barely understand you! The biggest spoiled brat in this Zone has the nerve to act tough? You only came back now, after leaving your friends behind. Who was the coward who ran away?
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Never mind. Now that you've come back, I can hand you over to Lord Minotarumon. For some reason, all of ROG has been looking for you. When Lord Minotarumon sees what I can do, I'll become a ROG officer! Yahoo!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: W-what should I do? They're after me after all! I want to run... but I have to save Patamon! Shoutmon! Taiki! What should I do?!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Come on! Make up your mind! Don't worry. You've got a General on your side!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: To perform a DigiXross, choose the Fusion command. First, learn the combination move. Then gather the Digimon it needs and put them in your party!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.

english: Use the Tactics command for auto-battle! Full Power selects your strongest move and a target it can defeat. Conserve uses only physical moves, without spending MP. Guard puts all your effort into defense. Escape focuses entirely on getting away. If even one Digimon escapes, you can avoid the battle!
blocks.review_note: Opening and early-story lines translated from the Japanese ROM. Original human names and the requested DigiXross spelling are retained. The build wraps story text at 15 columns.
